title: Bundle manifest
description: Doc 01 section 7. A bundle is a zip carrying one board and everything needed to audit it without re-retrieving. Import never overwrites: imported rows keep their ids, and because ids are ULIDs collisions do not occur. Attempts, profile context, model keys and folder paths are never included.

exported_by.description: Display name only. Doc 10 section 8: a bundle carries no other identity.

includes.description: Which files the archive carries. events.jsonl is on by default; export without history drops it and every Step.task_packet.

counts.description: What the importer expects to find, so a truncated archive is caught before it is merged.

local_documents.description: The checklist the exporter shows before export, so nothing leaves by accident. Local document passages carry the text but never the file path beyond the file name.

text_withheld.description: True for a folder marked sensitive: offsets only, and export of the text is blocked. Doc 01 open question 2.

blobs.description: Content addressed. Hashes are verified on import; no code is ever carried.
